title: conformance.runner.Probe
description: Served by the runner (a real hub: the runner's instance; a fake hub: the hub itself). The library sends it through conformance.Send and conformance.Relay.

payload.description: fake hubs only: how the runner answers this request (conformance.md, Scripted answers); the service passes the payload unchanged

hubError.description: answer ServerMessage.error with this ErrorCode number (and message)

replyError.description: answer a Reply carrying this handler error

close.description: close the stream the request came on (UNAVAILABLE)

case.description: names the request for the runner (attempts, matching)

steps.description: one script per attempt of the same case; the last repeats

byHub.description: a script per fake hub id
